name: Mexico presidential election + INE quick count
evidence_note: retrospective sensitivity chosen after the 2024 result was known; pure-count v1 remains the headline; this version adds the official INE quick estimate and is scored separately
summary: With official quick estimate, scored separately: after INE's 23:50 release, mean absolute projection error fell from 0.80 to 0.66 points, but 90% coverage remained only 11%. Both markets were already 90% settled before the count, so this is not a market-lead claim.
